name: agentur/smart-job-finder
description: Smart Job Finder: job board with TCA/IRRE, slugs, categories, live filters, JobPosting structured data and PSR-14 publish notifications (mock mail / Slack webhook). Compatible with TYPO3 12, 13 and 14.

suggest.typo3/cms-redirects: Creates 301 redirects when a job slug changes
suggest.typo3/cms-scheduler: Run smart-job-finder:expire as a recurring task
suggest.typo3/cms-workspaces: Dispatches JobPublishedEvent when a workspace job is published to live
